content: Optimum health isn’t just about what you put into your body, it’s also about how you use it! Crazy Sexy Wellness host, Kris Carr speaks with Brian Clement about lifestyle choices that are integral to everyday well-being. Kris also chatted with Clement about his book, 7 Keys to Lifelong Sexual Vitality.
